tbesh_html:
1) to be like, resemble
1a) (Qal) to be like, resemble
1b) (Piel)
1b1) to liken, compare
1b2) to imagine, think
1c) (Hithpael) to make oneself like
1d) (Niphal)
Aramaic equivalent: de.mah (דְּמָה "be like" H1821)

strongs_1890.strongs_def: to compare; by implication, to resemble, liken, consider
strongs_1890.kjv_def: compare, devise, (be) like(-n), mean, think, use similitudes.
